# The classification corpus (spec 3003 doc 04 section 1.1).
#
# One case per line: input, kind, id, separated by tabs. Every input here is a
# shape a person can actually copy out of a browser or paste from a chat client.
# The test expands each x.com line across twitter.com, www.x.com,
# mobile.twitter.com and nitter.net, which all render the same graph and have to
# normalise to the same node, so the corpus this exercises is a few hundred cases
# rather than the hundred below.
